data.description: ASSUMABLE VA LOAN WITH LOW INTREST!! - 1-bedroom, 1- bathroom condominium located in the One Orleans Place community in Houston, TX. Built in 1979, this 746 square foot upper-level unit offers a quiet setting at the back of the gated complex, with a view overlooking the tennis courts. Residents have access to two swimming pools, two tennis courts, a clubhouse, and walking paths shaded by mature live oaks. The community is pet friendly and offers assigned covered parking along the Galleria Mall and various dining options.
